title: Export Saved Reports as CSV
purpose: Enable customers to export saved reports as CSV files with column headers, based on the stated customer need.

scope.text: Customers need to export their saved reports as CSV.

requirements.text: Customers need to export their saved reports as CSV.

stories.text: As a customer, I want to export a saved report as CSV with column headers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing saved report, when the customer exports it as CSV, then the output is a CSV file containing the report data.
Given a successful CSV export, when the exported file is opened, then its first row contains column headers.

edge_cases.text: Proposed check: behavior when a saved report contains no data rows should produce a CSV file whose first row still contains column headers.

dependencies.text: Owner for this capability is unknown.
Maximum report size supported by CSV export is unknown.
Permission rules governing who may export saved reports are unknown.
Delivery date for this capability is unknown.

risks.text: Exporting very large saved reports could be constrained by the unknown maximum report size, which is unresolved.

success_metrics.text: Proposed verification: a saved report can be exported and the resulting CSV file opens with its first row containing column headers.

open_questions: What is the maximum report size that CSV export must support?
What permission rules govern exporting saved reports, and which roles may export them?
